summary: One TypeScript program mixes Node and browser globals: types ["node"] and lib DOM apply to every included file, so Node-only APIs such as process.env type-check inside WebView code that would fail at runtime
evidence: apps/desktop/tsconfig.json:6 lib DOM; :12 types node; :14 include src/** and vite.config.ts; only vite.config.ts:6 needs Node types; no Node API usage in apps/desktop/src (Grep empty)
failure_scenario: Adding const host = process.env.FOO in src/lib/api.ts passes npm run check and throws ReferenceError: process is not defined in the WebView. Latent today. Unverified: whether Vite define rewrites process.env.* in client builds.
